description: Choose which hours of which days an ad squad's ads run (hours 0-23 in each viewer's local time), or run every hour. Snap allows this only on LIFETIME-budget ad squads, so it is refused on daily-budget ones. A narrow schedule lowers delivery. Undo works when a schedule existed before. Previews unless confirm=true. Two steps: confirm=false returns a preview and an approval_token; to apply, repeat the same arguments with confirm=true and that approval_token.

always.description: true = every hour of every day

approval_token.description: The approval_token returned by the preview of this exact request. Required with confirm=true.

confirm.description: false = preview only (nothing sent). true = apply; needs approval_token from the preview.

name: snap_set_ad_schedule
